didn't understand the expression templates well enough to understand

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: [stan-users] Eigen::MatrixBase?
parts:
On Saturday, January 10, 2015 at 10:50:56 AM UTC-5, Daniel Lee wrote:
I only see 647 instances (I'm on a branch) -- that's completely do-able by hand.

Any suggestions on testing that all of these things actually accept MatrixBase and how to test in the future for new functions? We just need a pattern to be included in the matrix tests.

I believe it is a design principle of Eigen that any function that is defined for a Matrix can be defined for a MatrixBase or similar. See

http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/TopicFunctionTakingEigenTypes.html

So, I guess the test is whether things still compile at the end.

We should also make stanc generate the model class with members that are derived from MatrixBase rather than being a Matrix per se. At least for R, that would allow us to use an Eigen::Map to reuse the memory that the object takes up in R's workspace. That would enable (non-Windows) users to do chains in parallel without creating as many copies of the data.

In addition, I once did a prototype of using file-backed matrices with Boost and Eigen::Map

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/stan-dev/WM0FnSHeUx8/tYkMuy_JU-gJ

As Bob said, the auto-diff would probably overwhelm the capacity before the data does in many situations, but it seems like we might make this option available for situations like Andrew's model of the universe where the data are highly structured but too big to load into RAM at once.

Ben
